title: RePro: Training Language Models to Faithfully Recycle the Web for Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2510.10681v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: High-quality data is a cornerstone of large language model (LLM) pretraining, yet its growth has not kept pace with the needs of frontier models. In this paper, we introduce RePro, a novel web recycling method that trains a relatively small LM with reinforcement learning to generate effective and faithful rephrasings of pretraining data. Specifically, we design one quality reward and three faithfulness rewards, optimizing the LM rephraser to convert organic data into high-quality rephrasings while maintaining its core semantics and structure. In our experiment, we train a rephraser as small as 1B parameters to recycle 72B tokens sampled from DCLM-RefinedWeb. translated_title: RePro：训练语言模型忠实地回收网络数据用于预训练
translated_abstract: 高质量数据是大语言模型（LLM）预训练的基石，然而其增长速度未能跟上前沿模型的需求。在本文中，我们提出了RePro，一种新颖的网络数据回收方法，该方法通过强化学习训练一个相对较小的语言模型来生成有效且忠实的预训练数据改写。具体而言，我们设计了一个质量奖励和三个忠实度奖励，优化语言模型改写器将原始数据转换为高质量改写，同时保持其核心语义和结构。在实验中，我们训练了一个仅有1B参数的改写器，从DCLM-RefinedWeb数据集中回收了720亿个token。在400M、1.4B和2.8B模型上的预训练结果表明，RePro在22个下游任务上相比仅使用原始数据的基线实现了3.7%-14.5%的相对准确率提升，是使用提示词驱动70B模型的最先进网络回收方法所获性能提升的两倍。
tldr: RePro通过强化学习训练仅1B参数的小型语言模型，忠实地改写回收网络数据用于预训练，在22个下游任务上相比仅使用原始数据实现了3.7%-14.5%的相对准确率提升。
en_tdlr: RePro trains a small 1B-parameter language model with reinforcement learning to faithfully recycle web data for pretraining, achieving 3.7%-14.5% relative accuracy gains over organic-only baselines across 22 downstream tasks.
